name: Los Cabos International Airport

handling.v: the operator GAP lists PRIMESKY, a private FBO inside Los Cabos airport

runway.v: One runway 16-34, effective length 3,000 m x 45 m (60 m including paved shoulders). The same filing plans a second runway of 3,120 m x 45 m; whether it is built was not checked. From an undated environmental impact statement (filed 2020) by AFAC; check AIP AD 2.12 before a performance-critical trip
runway.quote: La pista existente tiene una longitud efectiva de 3000 metros y 45 metros de anchura

notes: IATA SJD and ICAO MMSD are shown on GAP's private aviation page ('Codigo IATA SJD, código OACI MMSD'). Mexico AIP (aipmexico.seneam.gob.mx, AD 2 MMSD) could not be read (site refuses automated reading, robots). GAP's 'Sobre el aeropuerto' page gives no runway, hours or customs data. 1 Nov 2026: nothing new verified. GAP pages https://www.aeropuertosgap.com.mx/es/los-cabos.html and https://www.aeropuertosgap.com.mx/en/los-cabos-3.html give no runway, hours or customs data; GAP 20-F for 2020 on sec.gov read in part, no Los Cabos runway data found. AIP AD 2 MMSD on aipmexico.seneam.gob.mx still blocked. | 3 Nov 2026: AIP AD 2 MMSD (https://aipmexico.seneam.gob.mx/AIP/doc/AD/AD_2/59_MMSD/AD_2-MMSD-2.pdf) refused (robots). A DOF resolution changing the airport's minimum ordinary operating hours (2 Apr 2015, https://www.dof.gob.mx/nota_detalle.php?codigo=5387668&fecha=02/04/2015) exists but was refused (robots), so hours not verified. Anexo 4 RGCE 2026 lists the San José del Cabo customs section for import and export of goods (Mon-Fri 08:00-17:00); not recorded as customs. GAP's private aviation page names the FBO Primesky, no runway, hours or customs. 5 Nov 2026: nothing new. Two DOF items surfaced by a search on the airport's operating hours were refused (robots), content unknown: https://dof.gob.mx/nota_detalle.php?codigo=5526346&fecha=13%2F06%2F2018 and https://www.dof.gob.mx/nota_detalle_popup.php?codigo=5585985. https://www.proyectosmexico.gob.mx/proyecto_inversion/302-aeropuerto-de-los-cabos/ refused (robots). Older GAP annual reports appeared in search; not opened, as they are out of date and a runway figure from them would not be better than the blocked AIP. | 7 Nov 2026: added runway from the AFAC environmental impact statement 'Ampliación de la Capacidad del Aeropuerto Internacional de Los Cabos, B.C.S.' (SEMARNAT file 03BS2020V0025, no date in the text; filed 2020), which names one runway 16-34 and plans a 'Segunda Pista' of 3.12 km; it states night-operation visual aids but no hours or customs. Could not be opened: AIP AD 2 MMSD https://aipmexico.seneam.gob.mx/AIP/doc/AD/AD_2/59_MMSD/AD_2-MMSD-2.pdf (permission request not answered, blocked). | 10 Nov 2026: nothing new. AIP AD 2 on aipmexico.seneam.gob.mx not opened (permission not answered for the MMUN file today, so the MMSD file was not tried). Searches for GAP pages with operating hours, customs or runway data found only news, Wikipedia copies and the already-used AFAC 2020 environmental statement.
